== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
Mary Jane was born in 1836. 
<ref>Age 62 at death</ref>
She was the daughter of Samuel Glasgow, and lived at Killycurragh , spinster, as of 1875.

On 14 Dec 1875 at 1st Cookstown Presbyterian, se married widower James Parke of Craigs, Oritor, son of Andrew Park. Witnessed by Ben Glasgow and Robert Moore.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/50ecb32857478 James Park, Mary Glasgow, 1875, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

She passed away 21 May 1898 age 62 at Craigs. Attended by James Park, widower.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/4475fa3681317 Mary Park, 1898, Cookstown, 62] at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths</ref>

Mary Jane was buried in Forthill Cemetery together with her husband. <ref> https://discovereverafter.com/profile/32845998
</ref>
A marriage for Mary Glasgow and Park was registered on 14 December 1875 in the Cookstown district.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/marriage GRONI civil marriage index], 14 December 1875, Cookstown district, M/1875/L1/1118/1/157.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1698]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Samuel’s held Killycurragh will account specifically names this daughter. The named family and local chronology distinguish him from Samuel of Gortin; later married identities do not undo the recorded natal relationship.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the registered will and compare the daughter’s marriage father/residence.
